description: Machine-readable field semantics contract enforcing research constraints for Sikkim landslide intelligence.

forbidden_mappings.reason: Zenodo Year represents imagery observation/acquisition year, NOT failure or event occurrence date.
District assignment by string matching is forbidden. Attribution must be spatial join against boundary valid at event date.
Road proximity does not imply road blockage or damage. Blockage requires documentary evidence in road_impact_reports.
WorldPop / GHSL figures are DERIVED or ESTIMATED, never OBSERVED. Census 2021 was not conducted.
GSI NLSM susceptibility map must never be used as ML training target or hotspot component.
Bhuvan Atlas summary figures must not be added to point/polygon inventories to prevent double counting.
NASA GGLI rows are cell-days, not events. GGLI and COOLR must not both be ingested as event inventories.
